results.name: Seven domains and fourteen distinct source tasks
Duplicate source delivery does not duplicate workload
Service visibility filters before counts and routing
Overdue, due today and unknown dates remain distinct
Returned work retains first-submitted and current-cycle age
Queue views separate ownership, submission, returns and history
Search and domain filters never retain unrelated rows
Unknown due dates sort after known source dates
Every source resolves to its domain-owned destination
Mismatched source, screen and unsupported revision fail closed
Stale revision requires explicit current revision selection
Historical superseded source cannot be relabelled as its successor
Unavailable and revoked links do not expose source data
Read-only observer and terminal items remain read-only
Partial result omits unavailable domain; failed and empty distinct input states
Sent, received and accepted carry distinct evidence
Malformed saved view criteria cannot be applied
Reading, filtering and routing never mutate source records
